ios.desc:
Look closer. What do you see? And now... what will you create?

Like the classic 'magic eye' pictures that once held our gaze, Subliminal Words is a captivating visual puzzle game filled with secrets hidden in plain sight. Subliminal words, famous faces, and hidden terms are cleverly camouflaged within each image, emerging only as you focus.

- NEW: CREATE, PLAY & SHARE YOUR OWN LEVELS! -
The hunt just got endless! What began as a quest to find hidden words has expanded into a massive, community-driven brain teaser experience. With our brand-new Level Maker, YOU can design the ultimate visual puzzles:
• Create: Build your own custom optical illusions and hide secret words within them.
• Play & Test: Solve your personalized puzzles to ensure your secrets are perfectly camouflaged.
• Submit for Review: Send us your custom levels! Once accepted, your creations will be published globally and playable by thousands of players worldwide.

ENDLESS VISUAL PUZZLES
Test your "super sight" across 500+ official levels and a constantly growing library of user-generated content. Can you:
• Beat Community Puzzles: Conquer fresh visual challenges designed by players just like you!
• Discover hidden words from mesmerizing scenery.
• Spot the Stars: Find famous celebrities sneakily blended into complex scenes.
• Find the Athlete: Hunt for secret football lingo and identify iconic players.

With our flexible, live-updated system, you get new community levels, daily puzzles, new categories, and live quests instantly—without ever needing to update the app. The puzzle-solving hunt never ends!

Enjoy a clean and intuitive UI, choose your favorite color themes, and use helpful hints when an illusion leaves you truly stuck.

How sharp are your eyes—and how creative is your imagination? Download Subliminal Words now to start hunting and creating your own masterpieces!

EULA: https://indest.ee/eula
